999008199.text: そろそろ、船の墓場の入口に差し掛かるところですね

localizations.en: We're approaching the entrance to the ship graveyard.

999008199.text:
なんだか、いやーな匂いが海から漂ってきてる……
これが藻の匂いなのかな

localizations.en: Ugh, something smells nasty... Is that what the seaweed smells like?

999008199.text: とにかく、慎重に船を進めよう

localizations.en: In any case, let's proceed with caution.

999008199.text:
うわー、もじゃもじゃだ！　うわー！！
それに、そこら中に浮かんでるのって……

localizations.en: Whoa, it's all tangled and gross! Whoa!! And what's that stuff floating all over...?

999008199.text: 襲われた船の残骸……
なるほど、これは確かに文字通り、船の墓場ね……

localizations.en: I see. Then this really is a ship graveyard in the most literal sense...

999008199.text:
今のところ危険はなさそうだが……
まずはゆっくり進んで観察するとしよう

localizations.en: We don't appear to be in immediate danger... Let's advance slowly and just observe for now.

999008199.text:
あの……私の気のせいだったらいいんですけど
あの藻、動いてません？

localizations.en: Um... I hope I'm just imagining this, but isn't that seaweed moving?

999008199.text:
じわじわと広がって
こっちに向かってきてるような……

波で流されてるんじゃなくて？
あ、でも……ほんとに！？

localizations.en: Isn't it just drifting with the waves? Wait... it really is moving?!

999008199.text: いけません……！　引きずり込まれます！

localizations.en: Look out...! We're being pulled in!

999008199.text: わ、わわっ！？
きぃえぇいっ！！
せやあぁぁぁっ！！

剥がれた！
今のうちに引き返すぞ！

localizations.en: We're free! Let's retreat while we can!

999008199.text:
危なかったあ……あのままだったらアタシたちの船も
墓場入りしてたよね

localizations.en: That was way too close... Any longer and our ship would've joined the graveyard!

999008199.text: なんなのよあれ。ただの藻には見えなかったわよ

localizations.en: What the heck was that? That was no ordinary seaweed.

999008199.text:
アルビーナが言っていた、墓場を縄張りにする魔物の
仕業だろうか？

localizations.en: Could this be the work of a monster, like Alvina mentioned, that's made the graveyard its territory?

999008199.text: 千歳、そのような気配は感じたか？

い、いえ……奥のほうから、微かに邪気のようなものは
感じられましたが……

localizations.en: N-no... while I could sense some faint malevolent energy coming from deeper within...

999008199.text: あの藻自体には、特に……

localizations.en: The seaweed itself didn't seem particularly unusual...

999008199.text:
元々、近づいたものに絡みつく性質を
持っているんでしょうね

localizations.en: It probably has a natural tendency to entangle anything that comes near.

999008199.text:
ただ……藻が生息範囲を拡大しているのは、
その魔物が原因なのかもしれません

localizations.en: However... a monster might be the reason the seaweed is expanding so quickly.

999008199.text:
確かに、強力な魔物の存在が、周囲の環境に影響を
及ぼす例は多いからね

localizations.en: Sound theory. There are many cases where a powerful monster's presence affects its surrounding environment.

999008199.text: ま、そいつも藻と一緒にまとめて倒しちゃえばいいのよ

localizations.en: That makes things easy, we just need to take out whatever is responsible along with all the seaweed.

999008199.text:
しかし、藻を１つ１つ斬って回ったのでは
一生かけても終わらんぞ。どう対処したものか

localizations.en: However, getting through the seaweed itself would take a lifetime. How should we approach this?

999008199.text:
こういう時こそ、錬金術の出番だよ！
ね、レスナちゃん！

localizations.en: This is exactly when alchemy shines! Right, Resna?!

999008199.text:
うん。藻の残骸を調べて、
除去する方法がないか考えてみるよ

localizations.en: Yeah. I'll examine the seaweed remnants to see how we might be able to deal with it.

999008199.text: 錬金術士のお手並み拝見、だな

localizations.en: Show us what an alchemist is capable of.

999008199.text:
東メンソスまでの航路は開けていますし、
アトリエにも行き来できるようになりました

localizations.en: The route to East Mensos is open, so we should be able to freely travel to and from the atelier now.

999008199.text: 一度アトリエに戻って、対処法を練りましょう

localizations.en: Let's head back and figure out a solution.
